This adverse development primarily relates to the 2022 underwriting year, where the estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred increased from GBP 19,208k at the end of 2022 to GBP 49,527k one year later. The report does not explicitly state specific causes for this strengthening, but given the syndicate's early stage of development and the inherent uncertainty in initial reserving for long-tail and volatile business classes, it can be attributed to adverse claims development and recalibration of IBNR estimates.

inherent uncertainty in the claims estimation process
